headline: Wall Street Is Losing Confidence in GoDaddy’s (GDDY) AI Strategy. Should Investors?
summary: GoDaddy Inc. (NYSE:GDDY) beat consensus estimates on both revenue and earnings, but that wasn’t enough to prevent the stock from dropping 12%. The market’s reaction makes it clear that investors are paying more attention to the company’s future outlook than its recent results. This is not a story about an earnings miss.
